git_commit: (pre-registration commit; the result is added in a later commit)
status: PRE-REGISTERED, descriptive diagnostic -- nothing fitted for use, selected, tuned or recalibrated. Interim plan section 4 (calibration diagnostics on historical development data) and task G1 of research/INTERIM_PLAN_AUDIT.md.
why: The registered 2,000-hour checkpoint reports calibration by weekday/weekend and by six-hour block of the day (research/LIVE_EVALUATION.md rule 5; agent/research/live_checkpoint.py slices). E026 gave a development reference for the regime slice only. Without one for these slices, a live wobble in a slice could not be told apart from how the model family always behaved there.
data: The same walk-forward out-of-sample predictions as E026 (E013/E018 setup: 27 folds, expanding window, Platt on a purged 90-day slice; agent/research/feature_count.prepare + evaluate), development period only, exploration and validation separately. Slices defined exactly as the checkpoint defines them: weekend = Saturday or Sunday UTC; hour blocks 00-06, 06-12, 12-18, 18-24 UTC of the reference hour. No prospective outcome is read; no holdout candle is loaded.
validation_wear: About 24 earlier experiments have examined the validation period; this is a descriptive reference, not a test of anything that could be adopted.
metrics: Per slice and period: rows, mean stated probability, observed large-move share, stated minus observed with a 95% circular block-bootstrap interval (48h blocks, 500 resamples), ECE.
hypothesis_H: In every slice (weekday, weekend, 00-06, 06-12, 12-18, 18-24), in both periods, |mean stated - observed| <= 0.02 and the interval of the difference contains 0.

what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.H_holds_in_a_slice: The model family was calibrated in that slice historically; a live offset there at 2,000 hours would be new behaviour, reported as such (descriptive, never a basis for switching models).
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.H_fails_in_a_slice: An offset in that slice is a known property of the model family; the live slice at 2,000 hours is read against this development offset, not against zero.
what_each_answer_means_decided_in_advanc.in_every_case: Nothing about the frozen model, its calibration, the live signal or any checkpoint rule changes.
